name: insimul-unreal-tooling
comment: `check` is the toolchain-free gate — a structural scan plus the corpus
manifest. `check:host` compiles the PORTABLE slice of the runtime module
and runs it against the golden fixtures; it needs only cmake and a C++17
compiler (no Unreal, no UBT), so the merge gate runs it too. It drops the
libinsimulcore legs with a configure-time WARNING when no native build is
beside it — read that warning rather than the pass count.

scripts.check:host: cmake -S verify-unreal -B verify-unreal/build && cmake --build verify-unreal/build && ctest --test-dir verify-unreal/build --output-on-failure
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run check:host
